functions.name: app_dir
functions.done: Returns an object whose methods build the same application cache, log, data, config, and site paths as rappdirs 0.3.4 for fixed appname, appauthor, version, expand, and os.

check.case: ggplot2_app <- app_dir("ggplot2", "hadley"); c(ggplot2_app$cache(), ggplot2_app$log(), ggplot2_app$data(), ggplot2_app$config(), ggplot2_app$site_config(), ggplot2_app$site_data(), ggplot2_app$os)

proof.r:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(rappdirs))
stopifnot(identical(as.character(packageVersion("rappdirs")), "0.3.4"))

json_str <- function(s) {
  if (length(s) != 1 || is.na(s)) return("null")
  s <- enc2utf8(s)
  s <- gsub("\\", "\\\\", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub('"', '\\"', s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("\n", "\\n", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("\r", "\\r", s, fixed = TRUE)
  paste0('"', s, '"')
}

one <- function() {
  ggplot2_app <- app_dir("ggplot2", "hadley")
  c(
    ggplot2_app$cache(),
    ggplot2_app$log(),
    ggplot2_app$data(),
    ggplot2_app$config(),
    ggplot2_app$site_config(),
    ggplot2_app$site_data(),
    ggplot2_app$os
  )
}

value <- one()
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
cat(sprintf(
  '{"value":[%s],"median_ms":%.17g}\n',
  paste(vapply(value, json_str, ""), collapse = ","),
  median(elapsed) * 1000
))

import json
import statistics
import sys
import time

sys.path.insert(0, "/home/ahmed/killr_projects/killr/packages/rappdirs")

from rappdirs.appdir import app_dir


def one():
    ggplot2_app = app_dir("ggplot2", "hadley")
    return [
        ggplot2_app.cache(),
        ggplot2_app.log(),
        ggplot2_app.data(),
        ggplot2_app.config(),
        ggplot2_app.site_config(),
        ggplot2_app.site_data(),
        ggplot2_app.os,
    ]


value = one()

    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()

import json
import statistics
import sys
import time

sys.path.insert(0, "/home/ahmed/killr_projects/killr/packages/rappdirs")

from rappdirs.site import site_config_dir


def _add(out, value):
    if isinstance(value, list):
        out.extend(value)
    else:
        out.append(value)


def one():
    out = []
    _add(out, site_config_dir("rappdirs"))
    _add(out, site_config_dir("R", os="mac"))
    _add(out, site_config_dir("R", os="win", appauthor="Posit"))
    _add(out, site_config_dir("rappdirs", os="unix"))
    _add(out, site_config_dir("rappdirs", os="unix", multipath=True))
    _add(out, site_config_dir("app", version="%V"))
    _add(out, site_config_dir("app", version="%v"))
    _add(out, site_config_dir(None))
    _add(out, site_config_dir(""))
    _add(out, site_config_dir(["a", "b"]))
    return out


value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)

print(json.dumps({"value": value, "median_ms": statistics.median(elapsed)}))
